en.headline: Two men arrested for drink-driving in New Territories North
en.dek: Police said a two-day road operation in Tuen Mun and Sheung Shui found two local drivers who failed breath tests; both were released on bail.
body: Police said two local men were arrested on suspicion of drink-driving during a two-day traffic operation in New Territories North that ended on Saturday.

The New Territories North traffic enforcement and control task force ran the operation, codenamed Quickchaser, on 11 and 12 September to target drink-driving, drug-driving and other traffic offences. Officers stopped vehicles that appeared unstable and required drivers to take breath tests.

Police said a 38-year-old driver surnamed Cheung was stopped on Yuk Hong Street in Tuen Mun and a 50-year-old driver surnamed Li on Castle Peak Road at San Hui. Both failed the breath test and were arrested. They were released on bail and must report to police in early October.
Police said drink-driving is a serious offence that can bring disqualification, a fine and imprisonment on conviction, and that enforcement would continue.

zh.headline: 新界北打擊酒駕 屯門及上水兩男未能通過呼氣測試被捕
zh.dek: 警方表示，11至12日在新界北展開代號「追捕者」行動，兩名本地男司機在屯門育康街及青山公路新墟段截查後涉嫌酒後駕駛，已准保釋。
body: 警方表示，新界北總區交通部執行及管制組特遣隊於9月11日及12日在區內展開代號「追捕者」的行動，打擊酒後駕駛、毒後駕駛及其他交通違例，行動中拘捕兩名本地男子。
警員在區內截停多輛懷疑行車不穩的車輛，並對司機進行酒精呼氣測試。當中在屯門育康街截獲一名38歲姓張男司機，以及在青山公路新墟段截獲一名50歲姓李男司機，兩人均未能通過測試，涉嫌酒後駕駛被捕。
兩人已獲准保釋候查，須於10月上旬向警方報到。
警方重申，酒後駕駛屬嚴重罪行，一經定罪可處停牌、罰款及監禁，並會繼續加強執法。
